1. The Council determines that the attacks of 9 March against undersea infrastructure in the eastern Baltic constituted a deliberate act against the security of the Alliance.
2. The Council authorises the measures set out in Annex A, with immediate effect.
3. The Council records that this determination was reached after eleven sessions, over forty-seven days, and that it was reached at last under conditions of duress created by the actions of a serving officer of one of its member states.
4. That officer’s conduct is not thereby excused, mitigated or in any way approved.
5. The Council does not consider it necessary to record anything further on the subject.
FM: ALLIED MARITIME COMMAND TO: COMMANDER, TG NORTHWIND DTG: 250415Z APR 28 SUBJ: OPERATION STEADFAST LANTERN - FINAL PHASE

1. (S) The Council has decided. The determination Vahl closed a strait to force was signed at 0407 this morning, six weeks and two days after he first asked for it.
2. (S) He has been informed. He has not opened the approaches.
3. (S) Remaining Nordverband strength is assessed at two air-defence destroyers, one Type 212A boat and the flagship, concentrated in the Bornholm Basin. Open water, with nothing left out there to complicate the problem.
4. (S) You are to bring the operation to an end.
5. (S) The following is not an instruction and will not appear in the operational record. The political staff would prefer this concluded with Konteradmiral Vahl alive and in custody rather than on the bottom of the Baltic, for reasons that are entirely to do with the inquiry and not at all to do with sentiment. Nobody will order you to arrange that. Nobody will criticise you if you do not.
6. (S) It will be decided by what you choose to shoot at, and by nothing else.
7. (S) Good hunting, Commander.
